newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SEVERIN'S U.S. VISIT ON ROMANIA FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.
newsitem.headline: SEVERIN'S U.S. VISIT ON ROMANIA FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.

text.p: Romanian Forign Minister Adrian Severin will meet U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright on April 21 during a visit to Washington, ministry spokeswoman Gilda Lazar told journalists on Wednesday.
Severin will brief Albright on Romania's efforts to join NATO in the first wave.
The ministry's news briefing agenda also included:

* Romania's inter-ministerial committee for European integration will meet on March 17 to discuss Romania's participation to the third session of Romania-E.U. Association Committee on March 24 in Brussels.

* Some 60 British businessmen are expected to arrive in Bucharest on March 16. The group is expected to discuss with Romanian government officials and representatives of the banking community ways to boost British investments in Romania. The British delegation will also attend the "British Business Day" on March 18.
* Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis will arrive on March 20 for a two-day visit. He will meet Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and President Emil Constantinescu .
